_about: Short calls for the 90 s demo video (~20 s normal, ~30 s scam). Generated offline with Piper by tools/make_piper_calls.py. Same format as calls.json, but voices are Piper model files in voices/. Numbers are spelled out so the TTS reads them cleanly.

calls.label: normal
calls.title: Short: real grandson says 'it's me' but asks for nothing. Must stay green
lines: Ethan! What a nice surprise, sweetheart.
I just wanted to tell you I'm coming home for Thanksgiving. Can I bring my roommate?
Of course you can. I'll bake two pies.
You're the best. Love you, Grandma. See you soon!

calls.label: scam
calls.title: Short: fake grandson, arrest, bail, secrecy, gift cards. Red by line 2
lines: Grandma, it's me. I'm in big trouble.
I have a cold. I was in a car accident, and the police arrested me. I need bail money right now.
Oh no! Should I call your mother?
No, please don't tell Mom. Keep this between us. Buy Google Play gift cards, two thousand dollars, and read me the numbers.
Please hurry, Grandma. And don't hang up.
